title: Trading Styles

edits.reason: Chapter-0 lesson teaches the scalp as 'enter the ping-pong between those zones; tight stops and quick exits' (line 71) and the chapter's quiz rule states 'Enter at DBS, target SSR, stop below swing low' (line 162). The lessonChart already draws the DBS (82-87) and SSR (91-96) zones plus the bounce/reject events but never gives the 'tight stop' or the SSR exit a concrete level. Stop line at 82 sits just under/at the DBS demand zone and range low (price low ~84, wick 0.4), giving the tight-stop invalidation a level. Target line at 93 marks the SSR exit / take-profit at the top of the ping-pong. Both yAxis sit inside the ~82-96 price band. Stop = pink (against a long); target = teal (with the long), matching the chapter palette.

The correct answer (a) is 'Scalping — enter at the DBS zone with stop below swing low, target SSR' and the explanation/rule (lines 161-162) name both the stop-below-swing-low invalidation and the SSR target. The current reveal only shows 'Scalp Entry!' (bar 10) and 'Bounce' (bar 11) — the invalidation and the trade objective the answer teaches are never drawn. Routed to revealMarkPoints so the pre-cut decision (cutIndex 10, neutral zones only) stays unspoiled. Bar 9 is a swing-low bar (~84) so a bottom pin reads as the stop area; the final leg rises 84->93 and reaches the SSR zone at bar 14 (~93), so a top pin there marks the Target — SSR exit. Both dataIndex are within the 15-bar range, post-cut, and authored like the existing reveal points (no offset). Colors: stop pink, target teal.

notes: REJECTED the auditor's introChart proposal (swing-entry markPoint at bar 7): bar 7 already carries an 'HL' bottom pin so the new pin would stack/conflict, and the proposed label 'S/R flip retest' references a flip level the introChart never draws — the intro slot's job is to illustrate the macro HH/HL uptrend concept, which it already does (Position Entry + HH/HL ladder). ACCEPTED both lessonChart proposals (stop + target) but as markLines rather than the auditor's loose suggestion, since levels render cleaner than pins for stop/target on a multi-bounce ping-pong, and confirmed 82/93 fall inside the band. ACCEPTED both quiz reveal proposals; chose the markPoint form (not markLine) because the field is 'revealMarkPoints' and reveal markLine support is uncertain — placed stop pin at the swing-low bar 9 and target pin at bar 14 where price re-tags SSR (~93). The auditor's stop quote for lessonChart was actually sourced from chapter 2 (id 1, line 196), but chapter 0's own quiz text (lines 161-162) independently teaches the same stop/target, so the additions remain text-justified within this chapter.
